summary: Track daily and weekday habits with local streaks.
page_description: An offline habit tracker for daily and weekday habits, with streaks, weekly statistics and a backup you can copy to your computer.
release_notes: Today says that tapping a habit marks it done, and the skip buttons sit under a heading that says what they are for. Buttons in a row are now the same width, headings are set in a serif, and dialogs show their two answers side by side.
